site_name: Garages Adjacent to 33 Richmount Gardens, Blackheath, SE3 9AE
description: An application submitted under Section 96a of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for a non material amendment in connection with the planning permission dated 07/09/2023 (Reference: 23/0066/F) for 'Demolition of existing garages and the erection of two, 1 bedroom semi-detached bungalows with rear gardens, associated landscaping and parking. The amendments include:Minor internal reconfigurations to ensure full compliance with Part M4(2);Increase in unit depth (approx. 500mm);Removal of front entrance canopy;Revised internal layouts to provide required storage and accommodate utilities; Adjustment of winsow positions and cill heights; Removal of external side door to Plot 2 southern elevation and installation of replacement window; Relocation of air source heat pump positions; Minor updates to hard and soft landscaping to reflect layout and outside storage adjustments; Refuse strategy revised in accordance with Royal Borough of Greenwich guidance and updated on the site plan; EV charging point shown for new car parking space; andAdjustment to roof pitch, resulting in:Increase of ridge height from 4.64m to 4.8mReduction of eaves height from 2.65m to 2.61m
